title: Fixed QC source follow-up routing
points: Failure case: follow-up questions such as source-page or QC audits could treat QC / quality-control wording as an unsupported ticker instead of staying scoped to the answer the user was auditing.
Source logic fixed: router guidance now preserves the prior ticker, source-page, and retrieved-evidence scope when the user asks to audit or map source pages for already returned data points.
Shipped result: source follow-ups stay on the relevant company and evidence trail, so users can inspect the original pages without triggering a false out-of-universe ticker path.
